caption: Two side-by-side photos of the same woman against a plain indoor background. In the left panel, labeled 'PROMPT ENGINEER' above, she has a skeptical, scrunched-up expression with furrowed brows. In the right panel, labeled 'SLOPERATOR' above, she looks wide-eyed and vacant, gazing slightly upward.
joke_summary: The term 'prompt engineer' is a self-flattering rebranding of someone who just types requests into an AI, mockingly relabeled 'sloperator' (slop + operator).
